name: camellia-plugins
description: Personal plugin marketplace for Claude Code

plugins.name: seed-kit
plugins.description: Lightweight PRD-first workflow with eleven user-triggered, decoupled skills: decision maps (wayfinder) for large foggy tasks, one-shot prototypes for run-to-know design questions, interview-driven PRDs, and gate-checked delivery. prd.md checkboxes track slice progress; `seed done` replays explicit checks and records done-logs; no evidence directory, task.json, or phase state machine.

plugins.name: tinder-kit
plugins.description: 基于任务级隔离（.forge）与 Seams 契约验证的工程 Agent 框架：原子技能解耦（User/Model 两层分治）、Handoff 上下文隔离交接、/develop 端到端无缝编排。
